row.name: admission_applications_sent_check
row.value:
(state = 'draft' or (state = 'withdrawn' and submitted_at is null)) = (submitted_at is null)
        and (submitted_at is null) = (reference is null)

row.name: admission_forms_names_check
row.value: (name_en <> '' or name_ar <> '') and char_length(name_en) <= 120 and char_length(name_ar) <= 120

row.name: admission_intakes_ages_check
row.value:
(min_age_months is null or min_age_months between 0 and 300)
        and (max_age_months is null or max_age_months between 0 and 300)
        and (min_age_months is null or max_age_months is null or min_age_months <= max_age_months)

row.name: admission_items_labels_check
row.value: (label_en <> '' or label_ar <> '') and char_length(label_en) <= 120 and char_length(label_ar) <= 120
